sections.introduction: Usba Ark is a traditional Ayurvedic distillate prepared from Usba Deshi, identified in the given reference as Anantamool (Hemidesmus indicus), commonly known in English as Indian Sarsaparilla. This medicinal root has long been valued in Ayurveda and traditional medicine systems for its blood-purifying, skin-supportive, and detoxifying properties. The distilled preparation, known as Ark, captures the subtle volatile and water-soluble therapeutic principles of the herb in a light, absorbable liquid form. It is especially recommended in disorders involving Rakta Dushti (impure blood) and chronic skin diseases. Usba Ark is considered beneficial in persistent dermatological conditions such as Khaj-Khujli (itching and pruritus), Phoda-Phunsi (boils and eruptions), chronic inflammatory skin changes, and pigmentary disturbances. It is also described as useful in long-standing toxic states associated with Upadansha (syphilitic conditions in classical terminology) and Sujak (gonorrheal disorders), where systemic impurities manifest through skin lesions. Traditionally, its action is compared to Sarsaparilla, reflecting its recognized role as a superior blood purifier.

Usba Ark 
 Introduction 
 Usba Ark is a traditional Ayurvedic distillate prepared from Usba Deshi, identified in the given reference as Anantamool (Hemidesmus indicus), commonly known in English as Indian Sarsaparilla. This medicinal root has long been valued in Ayurveda and traditional medicine systems for its blood-purifying, skin-supportive, and detoxifying properties. The distilled preparation, known as Ark, captures the subtle volatile and water-soluble therapeutic principles of the herb in a light, absorbable liquid form. It is especially recommended in disorders involving Rakta Dushti (impure blood) and chronic skin diseases. Usba Ark is considered beneficial in persistent dermatological conditions such as Khaj-Khujli (itching and pruritus), Phoda-Phunsi (boils and eruptions), chronic inflammatory skin changes, and pigmentary disturbances. It is also described as useful in long-standing toxic states associated with Upadansha (syphilitic conditions in classical terminology) and Sujak (gonorrheal disorders), where systemic impurities manifest through skin lesions. Traditionally, its action is compared to Sarsaparilla, reflecting its recognized role as a superior blood purifier. 

 Ingredients 
 
 Usba Deshi / Anantamool (Hemidesmus indicus) – 2.5 seer (~2.3 kg) 
 Warm Water – 20 seer (~18.5–19 liters) 
 

 Method of Preparation 
 The roots of Anantamool are coarsely crushed (Jaukut form) to expose their internal medicinal constituents. These are soaked overnight in warm water. This pre-soaking enhances extraction and softens the fibrous root structure. The next morning, the soaked mixture is transferred into a Nadika Yantra (Bhapka / distillation apparatus). Using moderate heat, approximately 20 bottles of Ark are collected through the distillation process. The final distillate is stored in sterilized bottles and preserved for therapeutic use. 

 Dosage and Anupan 
 
 2 to 5 tola (~24 ml to 60 ml) 
 Mixed with equal quantity of water 
 Administered morning and evening 
 

 Properties 
 Rasa (Taste) 
 
 Madhura (Sweet) 
 Tikta (Bitter) 
 

 Guna (Qualities) 
 
 Guru (Heavy) 
 Snigdha (Unctuous) 
 

 Virya (Potency) 
 
 Sheeta (Cooling) 
 

 Vipaka (Post-digestive effect) 
 
 Madhura (Sweet) 
 

 Dosha Effect 
 
 Pacifies Pitta 
 Balances Vata 
 Supports healthy Rakta Dhatu 
 

 Therapeutic Actions 
 Usba Ark is traditionally recognized for: 
 
 Rakta Shodhaka – blood purifier 
 Tvachya – supports healthy skin 
 Dahashamaka – relieves burning sensation 
 Vishaghna – counters toxic states 
 Pittahara – reduces excess heat 
 Kandughna – relieves itching 
 

 Indications 
 This preparation is beneficial in: 
 
 Rakta Dushti – blood impurities 
 Twak Vikara – skin disorders 
 Khaj-Khujli – itching / pruritus 
 Phoda-Phunsi – boils / eruptions 
 Red patches on skin 
 Dark skin discoloration 
 Chronic inflammatory dermatoses 
 Systemic toxic manifestations 
 

 Clinical Importance 
 In long-standing skin disorders, Usba Ark is administered continuously over time to gradually purify the blood and improve skin clarity. 
 It is especially valuable in conditions where toxins circulate through the bloodstream and manifest as eruptions, discoloration, or persistent irritation. 
 The reference also notes usefulness in chronic conditions associated with venereal toxicity, where systemic cleansing is required. 

 Comparison with Sarsaparilla 
 The text compares its action to Sarsaparilla, a globally recognized detoxifying herb. 
 Like Sarsaparilla, Anantamool supports: 
 
 Skin healing 
 Blood cleansing 
 Inflammatory balance 
 Cooling of excess internal heat 
 
 This makes it an effective indigenous alternative. 

 Precautions 
 
 Use under supervision in severe systemic illness 
 Continue for sufficient duration for chronic conditions 
 Maintain dietary discipline for best results 
 

 Conclusion 
 Usba Ark is a refined Ayurvedic distillate of Hemidesmus indicus, offering valuable support in blood disorders, chronic skin diseases, and systemic toxic states. Its cooling, purifying, and restorative properties make it a respected traditional remedy for long-term internal cleansing and dermatological health. As a gentle yet effective preparation, it remains a significant contribution to classical Ayurvedic therapeutics.
